events.title: The Founding of Ouvry
events.subtitle: The establishment of an independent Ouvrian state
events.description: The Ouvrian territories were consolidated under a single government, establishing the foundations of what would eventually become the modern nation.

events.title: The First Haszellian Expansion
events.subtitle: The beginning of a period of territorial growth
events.description: Haszell began expanding its influence into neighboring territories. Its growing political and commercial presence would eventually reshape relations throughout the region.

events.title: The Rise of Rivierra
events.subtitle: Rivierra emerges as a major maritime power
events.description: Rivierra's growing maritime presence established it as an increasingly influential force in regional affairs.

events.title: The Treaty of d'Razόn
events.subtitle: A landmark agreement between neighboring states
events.description: An agreement was reached establishing new arrangements for trade and diplomatic relations between the participating states.

events.title: The Dissolution of the Old Alliance
events.subtitle: The end of an established political arrangement
events.description: Longstanding political relationships began to deteriorate, leading to a period of realignment among the region's established powers.
